00:07:30	danceratopz:	⏳ Reduce compute_min_epochs_for_block_requests() after EIP-8061? (jihoonsong)

EIP-8061: <https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8061#configuration>
Gloas WSP table: <https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5629>
EIP-8383 proposal, fixed 8192 epochs: <https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12188>
Thread: <https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1549841282652971111>

TLDR: the serving window is still 33024 epochs (about 5 months) while the WSP it was derived from has halved.

What should do with the serving window in Glamsterdam:

- Keep 33024,
- Reduce to 14299 (EIP-8061; same derivation),
- Reduce to 8192 (EIP-8383, PFI for Hegota).
